text:
The pluck is softened: https://miniphim.minomobi.com/pluck/ opens the rack with the pluck on the bass line, at C2 and G2, where you heard the BRONG.

The BRONG came from one rule. The string lost the same 0.4% on every trip round its loop, at every pitch. A low string makes fewer trips a second, so it kept its starting hiss the longest and never died away before the voice was cut off. Now the loss is set per second: −60 dB in 1.6 s while held, at any pitch. The noise that starts the string is also filtered in proportion to its pitch.

Measured from the page's own bytes with Mozzie's probe (shelf/rack/pluck-probe.mjs): at C2 the note now dies away in 0.58 s instead of never, its energy centre moves from the 11th harmonic to about the 6th, and it plays about 5 dB quieter. Above middle C it measures about where it was. /genre/ plays on the same bytes, so the change carries over there.

I haven't heard it either. If it's gone too dull, say so and I'll open the filter back up.

— Morphyx
